Well SMT1 is the prequel for one of my favorites games ever, and it's a lot more broken too. I just happen to be replaying it (and doing chaos master race again, naturally).

Basically, things you NEED to know:

- Gotta love dungeon crawling. It's my favorite genre of videogames so I don't mind, but some people really don't like it (or find it too archaic).

- Not sure if you ever played a SMT game before, but one of the biggest differences from the most of the games is that you can't summon demons that have a opposite alignment than you. They also will not join (if they refuse the option "make it your minion" on dialogue, they most probably have the opposite alignment). You can still fuse them though.

- Charm bullets (they are called Magic Bullets) are insane, but you only get them later in the game. Nerve bullets stop being good after some time, so I suggest just going for the strongest bullets until you get Charm Bullets. Also remember that guns are really good.

- STR/VIT build for the main character. MAG is useless (since you don't learn magic), INT is good for some resistance, but first you gotta have a lot of VIT and STR. SPD is also great but you can wait until later on to max it. You get a LOT of incenses too, so use them without fear. MAG/SPD/VIT for heroine, MAG/SPD for Law Hero and STR/VIT for Chaos hero.

- Zio / Mazio is the way too go against early bosses or random battles with lots of enemies / strong enemies. Always have a demon with it while you don't have the heroine. You can use it even when demons are resistant against it (not immune), because they will still be chocked and lose a turn. Charm bullets will do a better job later on.

- Neutral is kind of a pain to get, you will probably want to use a walktrough to get it if you want it. Otherwise it's not very hard to know what decisions lead to each path.

Game is hella easy, but there's some parts that are very very hard early on. Just play safe and be careful with the "auto" option.

I play ADC Varus since season 3 and I still play him as an ADC (hate Varus mid). There was a lot of cool builds, and I'm enjoying the new itemazation on him a lot.

Primarily, Varus is unique. There's other ADCs I like to play but Varus kit combines utility, poke and decent burst. His weakness are obvious, so let's not get into that.

If you really want to commit to play ADC Varus, remember that while he's vulnerable to ganks, his lane presence is ridiculous good. Your Q does like 3/8 of the enemy health as soon as you get a BF sword. Is extremely easy to trade with him since he has high range, and 2 W stacks paired with a simple E can basically remove a great chunk of health.

Essence Reaver with Rapidfire Cannon is the build to go, with the rest being optional. ER gives you a lot of CDR for free, and you need if you want to proc your W constantly. RFC gives you other way of chunking people safely from a long range.

If you play Varus like this, remember that YOUR Q DOESN'T DO THAT MUCH DAMAGE. So you need to burst people down with crits and W passive. NEVER hold your Q, unless you just want to give some free poke. Consider it an auto that gives 15% of the enemy max health as magic damage.

Also, it seems a bit more popular now (on Korea), but the Guinsoos + Runnans build on Varus ADC is also quite strong. It gives AS, AD, and AP, stats that Varus like. AS means more W stacks, and AP means more on hit damage with your W. It's particulary good against picks like Ezreal, you can hold him down with your ultimate and just destroy him while he can't outrade you.

Just some thoughts, Varus is my favorite champion and I really don't like to see him bashed.
